Thanks again for the time today — really helpful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Primary product flows: interactive search and chat inside Finova's agent desk (high concurrency).
- Key decision criteria called out: p95 latency for interactive flows, unit cost per 1M tokens, and deployment mode (private vs dedicated).
- Stakeholders: technical (Rajesh / infra), procurement (procurement@finova.com), and economic buyer (Sara / finance).

Target metrics you mentioned:
- Latency: target p95 < 150ms for 1k token window on primary flows; acceptable up to 250ms for background/batch inference.
- Cost: target blended cost ideally < $600 / 1M tokens for production workload (we heard cost is a gating factor).
- SLA: production SLA and data residency controls are required for procurement/sign-off.

Proposed next steps:

Tim — thanks for the quick notes. Answers inline and next artifacts below.

1) Latency & Deployment:
- Production p95 target <150ms is achievable with Dedicated or Private deployments (pinned capacity and optimized kernels).
- For Hosted API (shared), typical p95 for similar customers is ~180-300ms depending on concurrency and sequence length. Hosted is fine for PoC but we recommend Dedicated for strict p95 SLAs.

2) Cost estimator:
- We're preparing a back-of-envelope for 200M tokens / mo. Ballpark: with Dedicated + batching optimizations and quantized model variant, we estimate unit cost in the range of $400–$700 / 1M tokens depending on steady concurrency and prefix caching. Rishi will attach a more detailed capacity_estimate.xlsx.

3) Security/SOC2 / Evidence:
- We can provide SOC2 Type II report, a customer-facing security whitepaper, and access logs/audit trails for Private/Dedicated modes. For Hosted we provide standard audit logs and limited retention options per plan.

Attachments (attached): Redwood_SLA_summary.pdf (concise SLA options for Hosted / Dedicated / Private), capacity_estimate.xlsx (Rishi's capacity/cost model).

Next steps:
- Rishi (cc) will share the capacity_estimate.xlsx by EOD.
- Marissa to schedule technical deep-dive with Rajesh and our infra team (proposed: Tue 7/13 10am PT).
- Procurement: please confirm preferred doc format and any redline windows.

If that all sounds good I'll loop in our security lead to respond to any questionnaire items.
